text:
tia (Sales): morning — quick async standup:
- did: synced with NovaHealth legal + infra, demoed Dedicated pilot config, handed off requirements to solutions.
- blockers: Nova legal flagged BYOK/HSM details; they want confirmation on on-prem key wrapping and audit retention before commit.
- today: need eng/security confirmation on KMS/HSM flow for Private (EU), PR review on airflow-change PR (#742), and a short note I can send to the customer.

raj (Solutions): thanks. Can someone confirm whether Private uses customer KMS keywrap (BYOK) for model artifacts + runtime keys? Customer specifically asked about using an HSM-backed key in their vault.

mike (Eng Runtime): short answer: yes, we support keywrap with customer-managed keys for artifacts; runtime session keys are wrapped by that KMS on provision. For HSM-backed keys we pass through to the provider; we don't host HSM ourselves. Need to check docs for exact audit retention window. Also pinged on PR #742 — left a couple comments.

mike (Eng Runtime): CI failing on the quant test in the PR:
```
FAIL test_quant_profiles.py::test_profile_match - AssertionError: expected 0.01 <= 0.03
Traceback: ...
```
Looks like rounding diff on the kernel selection. I'm reproducible locally, will try a quick fix.

sara (Security): for EU Private pilot: we need explicit audit retention >= 365 days for key unwrap ops and exportable logs for SOC review. Please add data classification tags to the intake doc (PII/PHI flags). Also need to confirm whether logs include key IDs (they should not include raw ciphertext).

tia (Sales): @mike — can you drop the exact wording I can send to legal (one para)? They want something concise about: "we do not persist customer key material; keys are HSM-backed in their KMS; audit logs retained X days"

mike (Eng Runtime): draft: "Redwood Private supports customer-managed KMS (including HSM-backed keys). We use key-wrap: customer keys never leave their KMS; Redwood stores wrapped keys and audit logs of unwrap events. Audit logs for KMS operations can be retained and exported per contract — propose 365 days for the EU pilot. We do not store unencrypted key material." Feel free to shorten.

amanda (Sales Ops): pinging for ETA on PR review — customer asked for an updated pilot timeline today. @mike @raj any chance of review by EOD? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

mike (Eng Runtime): I can finish review in ~2 hours, but I need the failing test vectors fixed or a repro from QA. If I can't get the fix in, I'll post a patch to revert the quant tweak and open a follow-up.

tia (Sales): QA repro (copied):
```
# sample prompt set used in perf test
prompts = ["Summarize the following clinical note:", "Extract entities from:"]
seed = 42
```
trying to be as minimal as possible.

raj (Solutions): temporary workaround for NovaHealth: route pilot traffic to Dedicated fallback in eu-west while eng stabilizes the runtime change. That keeps latency SLAs and avoids BYOK gate until we confirm audit wording. I'll update ticket #1234.

deploy-bot: staging deployment queued: job=deploy-staging-2026-03-17-09, user=mike. :package:

sara (Security): also: include a line that audit logs will not contain plaintext keys, only key IDs and operation metadata. That satisfies security cert folks.

mike (Eng Runtime): ack. I'll tweak the paragraph: "Audit logs include key IDs and operation metadata; no plaintext key material is ever logged or persisted."

amanda (Sales Ops): great — once PR is reviewed and the paragraph is finalized, can we get a one-paragraph approval note from security to attach to the SOW? If yes, I can push the contract.

tia (Sales): thanks team — I'll hold off on sending formal wording until we get security ack + PR status. If anyone needs anything from sales (test prompts, customer contact), ping me.

raj (Solutions): noted. I'll update the internal intake doc with the proposed 365-day retention and the fallback plan.

mike (Eng Runtime): leaving a final TODO:
- [ ] fix CI quant test or revert tweak (owner: mike)
- [ ] security approval paragraph (owner: sara)
- [ ] update intake doc + ticket #1234 (owner: raj)
- [ ] sales send legal note after ack (owner: tia)

tia (Sales): thanks — will follow up later. :thumbsup:
